# Synergy Stampings

> Synergy Stampings is a precision metal stampings and pressed components manufacturer at F-133, MIDC Ambad, Nashik, India, serving automotive and electrical OEMs. It is the stampings arm of the SCF Group, which has manufactured in Nashik since 2002 and reported Rs 52.26 Cr revenue in FY 2025-26.

Synergy Stampings handles the full stamping flow in one plant: process design, tool tryout, mass production and delivery management. The in-house tool room covers lathe, milling, drilling and boring; the press shop runs mechanical presses from 40 to 300 tonnes, including a SEYI SNX-110. Welding, plating and powder coating are available through the SCF Group at the same address.

## What buyers use us for
- Precision metal stampings: body and chassis brackets, reinforcements, frame add-on parts, general stampings
- Selector shafts, breaker shafts and welded linkage assemblies
- Core stampings, side assemblies and side plates for electrical programs
- Shock absorber outer tubes and suspension components
- Panel parts for electrical panel assemblies
- New tool build plus production programs

## Who the group supplies
- Mahindra & Mahindra (approved source), ABB India, BHEL, Gabriel India, Lauritz Knudsen, KPIT, Sharda Motors, Sipra Engineers

## How to buy
- RFQ with drawing upload (STEP, DXF, DWG, PDF): 24-hour engineer response
- NDA signed before drawing review when requested
- Group quality objectives: on-time delivery, 85% OEE, zero customer complaints
